timing: Reverse TPHC: photon starts; delayed preceding proton pulse stops. Higher channel means earlier physical time. Exact t=0 is uncalibrated (printed pp21-23).
counts: Unreduced Appendix2 counts, visually transcribed. Brackets around run151 channels70-81 are annotations, not digits: channel81 is452, not OCR4523. Printed zeros and edge channels remain stored.
background: Expected counts per channel = photon_background_per_s*acquisition_s*channel_width_us/pulse_period_us, following Appendix2 introduction, printed114.
alignment: Use first_full_channel as first full decay bin; the next larger channel contains the onset transition. Start of the first full bin after excitation is uncertain within one channel. Store that uncertainty, do not fit time zero to a preferred decay.
